title: Membership in a Prefix Language
statement: Let $\ell$ assign a natural number to each bit string, let $V$ be a language of bit strings, and let $q$ be a bit string. Then $q$ belongs to the language consisting of strings whose decoded first component determines the length bound and whose decoded second component can be extended after marker-dropping into a word of $V$ exactly when there is a bit string $s$ such that $\lvert d(\pi_2(q))s\rvert=\ell(\pi_1(q))$ and $\langle\pi_1(q),d(\pi_2(q))s\rangle\in V$, where $\pi_1,\pi_2$ are the total pair projections and $d$ is the marker-dropping transduction.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a function from bit strings to natural numbers
$V$ is a language of bit strings
